chunks: "Do not take from the pebbles of the Jamarat that have already been thrown."

key_terms.الْجِمَارِ: the Jamarat, the stoning sites in hajj
key_terms.حَصَى: small pebbles used in ritual stoning

ai.seo_question: Can pebbles already used in ramy al-jamarat be taken and reused?
ai.summary: This narration gives a legal instruction related to the rites of hajj, specifically the pebbles used for ramy al-jamarat. It prohibits taking and reusing pebbles that have already been thrown, indicating a rule concerning the proper manner of performing the ritual.
